 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH
ORAL ORDER 4 10-01-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the State .

2. Petitioner apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 406,
409 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code .

3 . As per the prosecution case , this petitioner along with other co-accused persons committed major irregularities in executing Mukhyamantri Peya Jal Nischaya Yojana in Gram Panchayat Rajala Ward No. 3 and after enquiry it was found Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.48044 of 2024(4)
dt.10-01-2025 that from account No. 34150110163750 , operated jointly by WIMC Chairman and Secretary on 28.02.2019 Rs. 13,60,700/- was transferred in account and on different dates between 01.03.2019 to 17.08.2019 Rs. 12,66,500/- transferred to co- accused persons, Md. Nesar, Sakaldeo Yadav, Md. Azaharuddin Ansari and ASM Digitranic Pvt, in advance , which is probhibited and punishable and as such all the accused persons including this petitioner misappropriated government fund.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is lady and at the relevant time petitioner was Ward Member-cum-Chairman of Gram Panchayat, Rajala and has committed no offence as alleged.
It is the Chairman and the Secretary who have been given cheques in different dates to the agent.

So , it is responsibility of the beneficial persons who have received all amounts by the Chairman and Secretary and as such no case under Sections 406, 409 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code is made out against this petitioner.

5 . Learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that advance withdrawal and transfer of money is prohibited and punishable but the petitioner being chairman of management committee with the help of Secretary Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.48044 of 2024(4) dt.10-01-2025 withdrew advance money and paid the same to co-accused persons who were responsible to complete their work and as such all the accused persons including this petitioner misappropriated government fund.
6 . Considering the nature of accusation and others circumstances of the case , prayer for pre-arrest bail of the petitioner is rejected.

(Prabhat Kumar Singh, J) Koushik/-
